visualCharacteristics.structure: image + heading + description + link + region list
visualCharacteristics.layout: 3 columns full-width, ~575px tall, overlay text band on lower portion, red square bullet before title, hover/expand reveals description and region selector

contentPattern: One row per division: cell 1 = background image; cell 2 = H2 title, description paragraph, 'Explore' link to the primary division site, followed by a bulleted list of region/language links (country - language) taken from the card's tabcontent panel. Block JS reveals the description/list on hover or '+' click.
